title: Multi-omics Mendelian randomization and cartilage transcriptomics prioritize genetic loci and candidate genes for osteoarthritis
score_reason: Focuses directly on multi-omics Mendelian randomization (MR) and transcriptomics integration for prioritizing genetic loci and candidate causal genes.
chinese_explanation: 该论文研究利用多组学孟德尔随机化（Multi-omics Mendelian randomization）结合软骨转录组数据，对骨关节炎的遗传位点与候选致病基因进行优先排查。该方法切中多组学数据整合与孟德尔随机化在因果基因筛选中的核心应用，具有直接的方法学与应用价值。

title: Genetic Determinants of Disease Trajectory in Sarcoidosis
abstract: Background: Sarcoidosis represents a complex inflammatory condition of unknown origin, characterized by diverse clinical profiles, particularly identifiable as Lofgren's syndrome (LS) and non-LS cases. Delving into the genetic underpinnings of chronic sarcoidosis phenotypes is essential for advancing our understanding and treatment of this disease. Methods: To classify chronicity, pulmonologists evaluated sarcoidosis phenotypes over a follow-up period of two years, distinguishing between chronic and nonchronic classifications. We assessed the genetics of these chronicity phenotypes in a Swedish cohort of 1,515 sarcoidosis cases (679 nonchronic and 836 chronic) alongside 3,085 controls using the Immunochip array. To confirm our findings, replication analysis was conducted in a German cohort of 1,216 sarcoidosis cases (485 nonchronic and 731 chronic) and 3,042 controls. A comprehensive meta-analysis of significant SNPs (p < 5e-8) was carried out using inverse variance weighting. Additionally, we employed gene-based analysis, enrichment mapping, and pathway analysis to gain deeper functional insights. Results: Our meta analysis uncovered significant genetic associations with chronic sarcoidosis phenotypes, including LS nonchronic (rs3135356; OR = 3.13, 95% CI: 2.38 - 4.12), nonLS nonchronic (rs2395162; OR = 2.34, 95% CI: 1.96 - 2.85), and nonLS chronic cases (rs1049550; OR = 0.68, 95% CI: 0.59 - 0.76). Specifically, gene based analysis revealed that CLIC1 is associated with nonchronic forms, while ANXA11 is linked to the chronic phenotype. Our enrichment analysis highlighted the expression of quantitative trait loci (eQTLs) in immune cells, whole blood, and lung tissues. The pathway analysis pinpointed the antigen presentation pathway as vital to understanding chronicity phenotypes. Conclusions: This study illuminates the distinct genomic features that differentiate chronic sarcoidosis phenotypes, underscoring the critical involvement of immune-related genes and regulatory networks. By advancing the knowledge of sarcoidosis chronicity, these findings pave the way for targeted therapeutic interventions and personalized treatment strategies that can significantly improve patient outcomes.
score_reason: Utilizes GWAS meta-analysis and tissue/cell-type eQTL enrichment analysis to pinpoint specific genes (CLIC1, ANXA11) and immune pathways driving disease chronicity.
chinese_explanation: 该研究结合了 GWAS 联合分析与组织及免疫细胞的 eQTL 富集分析，针对结节病（Sarcoidosis）的不同临床表型进行了遗传调控机制探索。论文指出了 CLIC1 和 ANXA11 等关键基因以及抗原递呈通路在表型分型中的作用，对基于 eQTL 的遗传表型解析提供了具体实证。

title: EpiPack: A computational framework for reference mapping and out-of-reference detection for single-cell ATAC-seq data with heterogeneous peak features
score_reason: Presents EpiPack, a methodological single-cell framework addressing reference mapping and out-of-reference cell detection under heterogeneous peak features in scATAC-seq.
chinese_explanation: 论文提出了 EpiPack 计算框架，旨在解决单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据中由于 Peak 特征异质性带来的参考图谱映射（reference mapping）与参考外新细胞类型检测问题。对于从事单细胞染色质可及性及计算基因组学算法设计的学者具有较高的方法学借鉴意义。

title: Network modeling identifies vitamin B2 control of AIFM2 deficit-driven hepatocyte death in MASLD
abstract: Drug discovery for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) remains difficult due to network effects. We developed MetaLiver, a public resource to identify druggable nodes within complex interactomes. It incorporates a MASLD-specific knowledge graph that improves bioactive compound contextualization while reducing computing time 18.8-fold. Layering progression-resolved bulk and hepatocyte-specific single-cell MASLD data onto this graph identified the vitamin B2-dependent flavoproteome (FlavProt) as an injury-sensitive network. Induced pluripotent stem cell-derived and primary human hepatocytes validated that flavin-cofactor replenishment mitigates FlavProt-dependent dysregulation, augmenting metabolic functions under cellular stress. Saturating flavin-cofactor availability blunted human immune cell activation. Clinically, a FlavProt expression score significantly correlated with poor outcomes in retrospectively stratified MASLD patients. We identified the oxidoreductase AIFM2 from this score and established experimentally that its injury-associated deficit causes hepatocyte death yet is controllable by flavin-cofactor availability. This study reveals the FlavProt as critical yet modifiable in MASLD and establishes MetaLiver for network discovery.
score_reason: Combines network modeling knowledge graphs with hepatocyte single-cell RNA-seq to prioritize druggable network nodes and mitochondrial pathway deficits.
chinese_explanation: 该研究开发了 MetaLiver 网络建模工具，整合了批量转录组与肝细胞单细胞 RNA-seq 数据，在代谢性肝病（MASLD）中识别出受维他命 B2 调控的 FlavProt 网络与 AIFM2 损伤机制。虽然研究偏向于特定疾病的药理机制验证，但其结合单细胞转录组进行网络靶点挖掘的设计值得关注。

title: Network modularity reveals context and state-dependent reorganization of time-varying functional connectivity in single-cell resolved neural activity recordings
abstract: An important goal of neuroscience is to understand how biological neural networks organize activity at multiple scales to enable complex information processing and behavioral output. To address this challenge, large-scale neural activity datasets with increased resolution and wider coverage have become more prevalent across many model systems. However, bridging the gap in scale between changes in pairwise functional connectivity between neurons and changes in brain-wide organization of activity remains a key challenge. In this work, we demonstrate application of modularity-based community detection and network modularity to single-cell resolved recordings, for the first time, as a method to summarize complex changes in time-varying functional connectivity, facilitating comparisons across multiple time windows, recordings, and conditions. We apply these methods to both single-cell resolved multi-cell and whole-brain activity recordings. In the multi-cell recordings, we find that food odor changes functional connectivity between existing network modules in a C. elegans locomotory interneuron network, rather than reorganizing them. In spontaneous whole-brain activity, we identify several key hub neurons and combinations that significantly destabilize module assignments when silenced. Together, these results demonstrate community detection and modularity as a method for detecting context and network state-dependent changes in functional connectivity at the intermediate scale of network modules in single-cell resolved neural activity. Results from these analyses facilitate future investigation of mechanisms that mediate organization of neural activity at intermediate scales.
score_reason: Applies modularity community detection to single-cell resolved neural activity imaging, which is methodologically distinct from scRNA-seq and genetic causal inference.
chinese_explanation: 该论文将网络模块化与社区检测算法应用于单细胞精度的神经元电/钙活动记录，探讨线虫和脑网络在不同刺激下的功能连接重构。尽管涉及单细胞分辨率，但其对象为神经功能成像而非单细胞基因组学或遗传因果推断（MR/eQTL），与核心研究方向契合度较低。

title: WAIVES: Weak-form Asymptotically-unbiased Instrumental-Variable Estimation for SDEs
abstract: Weak-form methods have transformed inference for deterministic dynamical systems. By integrating the governing equations against smooth, compactly supported test functions, they trade noise-amplifying differentiation for noise-attenuating integration, yielding fast and robust estimates. Extending this idea to stochastic differential equations (SDEs) has proven harder, and a consistent single-trajectory formulation has remained out of reach. Applied naively in the time domain, the weak form makes the regressors and the errors functionals of the same noise, creating endogeneity that leaves weak-form least squares biased and inconsistent. We resolve it with instrumental variables, a classical idea from econometrics. Weak-form integrals over nearby disjoint time windows prove to be valid instruments, correlated with the regressors yet uncorrelated with the error, restoring consistency and asymptotic normality. The resulting generalized-method-of-moments estimator, WAIVES (Weak-form Asymptotically-unbiased Instrumental-Variable Estimation for SDEs), requires only a linear solve, with no likelihood evaluations, filtering, or simulation. It is therefore an order of magnitude faster than exact-likelihood methods where those exist, and it applies unchanged where they do not, with standard errors and calibrated confidence intervals supplied by the moment conditions. It also separates measurement noise from the intrinsic randomness of the dynamics. Across nine example systems, spanning linear, bistable, chaotic, excitable, state-dependent-diffusion, non-polynomial, hypoelliptic, and high-dimensional regimes (up to 120 dimensions), WAIVES recovers nonlinear drift and diffusion with negligible bias and near-nominal interval coverage. We close with two real-data illustrations: a 167-year North Atlantic sea-surface-temperature record and an optical-tweezer calibration.
score_reason: Introduces WAIVES, an instrumental variable (IV) GMM estimator that resolves endogeneity in stochastic differential equations using disjoint time-window integrals as instruments.
chinese_explanation: 该研究提出了 WAIVES 方法，利用相邻不相交时间窗口的弱形式积分作为工具变量（IV），解决了随机微分方程（SDE）推断中的内生性（Endogeneity）偏误问题。该方法基于广义矩估计（GMM），无需似然评估或轨迹模拟即可实现一致的非线性漂移与扩散参数估计，为连续动态系统中的工具变量与因果推断提供了全新的可复用统计思路。

title: ReliFlow: Reliability-Calibrated Residual Transport for Combinatorial Single-Cell Perturbation Prediction
abstract: Predicting the transcriptional response to combined perturbations requires distinguishing interactions between interventions from errors in their individual effect estimates. The latter become more pronounced when single-perturbation evidence is sparse or withheld. We introduce a conditional flow-matching model that estimates the reliability of single-gene effects from training-only cross-fitting and uses those estimates to calibrate the additive source distribution. The velocity is decomposed into a known correction of the additive reference and a learned residual transport field. On Norman genetic perturbations, reduces mean absolute error (MAE) from 0.142 to 0.131 for unseen combinations of observed singles and from 0.198 to 0.178 when constituent singles are withheld. On held-out ComboSciPlex drug combinations, MAE decreases from 0.191 to 0.176. Non-additive residual correlation improves from 0.574 to 0.638, and component ablations identify the contribution of reliability weighting. The results indicate that accounting for uncertain constituent effects improves generalization to unseen genetic and chemical combinations, with a moderate increase in training cost.
score_reason: Presents ReliFlow, a conditional flow-matching framework for single-cell combinatorial perturbation prediction that calibrates single-gene effect uncertainty via cross-fitting.
chinese_explanation: 针对单细胞基因扰动（Perturb-seq）预测中组合效应难以建模的问题，该论文提出了 ReliFlow 框架。该方法通过交叉拟合估计单基因效应的可靠性，并利用残差运输场（Residual Transport Field）捕获非加性基因互作，显著提升了对未观察过的基因扰动组合在单细胞转录组层面响应的预测精度。

title: Genotype and environment shape gene regulatory variation in switchgrass
abstract: Local adaptation is contingent on genotype-by-environment interactions, which are often mediated by variation in gene expression. The causes and consequences of variation in gene expression are complex, and they are rarely evaluated under the multi-dimensional environmental regimes that occur in the field. Here, we investigate switchgrass gene expression variation in contrasting sites in Michigan and Texas. We examined differentially expressed genes between upland and lowland switchgrass genotypes and found that genes with genotype x environment (GxE) interactions were enriched for GO terms related to phosphorus metabolism. After mapping expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL) in a switchgrass diversity panel in both sites, we compared distinct categories of eQTL to investigate their effects on gene expression in contrasting environments and their evolutionary history. Cis regulatory variants are more likely to have consistent effects across sites, while trans regulatory variants were more likely to have site-specific effects, and are more likely to underlie changes in gene expression between sites. Lower minor allele frequency in trans regulatory variants is consistent with stronger purifying selection. Furthermore, site-specific regulatory variants exhibited intermediate minor allele frequencies, consistent with balancing selection or soft sweeps. Finally, motivated by enrichment for phosphorus-related genes exhibiting differential expression between sites, we conducted a GWAS for leaf phosphorus concentration in the diversity panel. By overlaying the GWAS results with the eQTL map, we characterized cis and trans regulation of candidate genes for leaf P concentration in Michigan and Texas. Together, this work provides novel insights on the molecular basis and evolutionary history of GxE interactions in switchgrass.
score_reason: Maps cis- and trans-eQTLs under multi-environment field conditions and integrates eQTLs with GWAS summary data for differential gene expression analysis.
chinese_explanation: 该研究在不同自然环境下对基因表达调控（eQTL）进行了深入剖析，系统比较了 cis- 与 trans-eQTL 的表型效应稳定性与演化选择特征。此外，文章将 eQTL 映射与叶片磷浓度的 GWAS 信号进行重叠与整合分析，为结合 GWAS 和 eQTL 研究环境交互与基因差异表达提供了典型的实验设计与分析范例。

title: Regularized ensemble polygenic risk prediction with GWAS summary statistics
abstract:
Nature Genetics, Published online: 18 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41588-026-02844-z

PUMAS-ensemble combines multiple polygenic risk scores using genome-wide association study summary statistics, improving genetic risk prediction across traits and ancestry groups without requiring individual-level training data.
score_reason: Develops PUMAS-ensemble, a method using GWAS summary statistics to construct regularized ensemble polygenic risk prediction without individual-level training data.
chinese_explanation: 该论文提出了 PUMAS-ensemble 方法，仅利用 GWAS 汇总统计数据（Summary Statistics）即可将多种多基因风险评分（PRS）进行正则化集成，无需个体级（Individual-level）训练数据。该方法显著提升了跨性状和跨群体遗传预测的准确度，对基于 GWAS 汇总数据的基因表达与表型推断极具实用价值。

title: Elysium: Simulation-Free Unbalanced Schrödinger Bridges
abstract: Reconstructing cellular dynamics from snapshots is challenging because the destructive nature of single-cell measurements makes tracking the same cells over time impossible. Cellular dynamics are inherently stochastic and involve changes in population size through proliferation and apoptosis. Growth-based methods represent population change as a rate on the density, which does not assign exits and entries to individual cells. Unbalanced Schrödinger bridges model individual events, but neural solvers for killed diffusion bridges simulate trajectories during training. We introduce Elysium, a simulation-free solver that jointly learns state transition and mass change. Using a killed Brownian reference and its time reversal, Elysium constructs direct regression objectives from an optimal endpoint coupling and conditional bridge distributions, without simulating trajectories during training. We show that the minimizers of the expected training objectives recover the optimal unbalanced Schrödinger bridge. Empirically, Elysium reconstructs state transitions, population size, and event distributions on simulated benchmarks with known killed-diffusion ground truth, outperforming existing deterministic and bridge-based solvers. On single-cell time courses, it interpolates cell state distributions at unobserved time points, tracks population expansion and contraction, and captures biphasic drug-response dynamics.
score_reason: Develops Elysium, a simulation-free solver for unbalanced Schrödinger bridges to model single-cell dynamics, cell state transitions, and mass changes.
chinese_explanation: 单细胞快照数据由于破坏性测量难以直接追踪同一细胞的演化轨迹，该研究提出了无模拟的不平衡薛定谔桥求解器 Elysium。它通过构建直接回归目标，联合学习细胞状态转移与细胞增殖/凋亡引发的群体质量变化，能够精确插值未观测时间点的单细胞状态分布并刻画复杂的细胞动态。

title: Tracing genetic risk of neurodegenerative disease through variants affecting microglial function
abstract:
Nature Genetics, Published online: 19 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41588-026-02839-w

We combined pooled differentiation of 261 human induced pluripotent stem cell lines into microglia-like cells with single-cell transcriptomics, cellular phenotyping and CRISPR screening to trace neurodegenerative risk variants through to microglial function. This approach identified genetic drivers that influence microglial differentiation, migration and phagocytosis, including disease-relevant effects at LRRK2 and TREM2.
score_reason: Combines pooled iPSC differentiation across 261 lines with single-cell transcriptomics, phenotyping, and CRISPR screens (Perturb-seq framework) to trace GWAS risk variants to microglial functional phenotypes.
chinese_explanation: 该研究将261个诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）系的混合分化与单细胞转录组学、细胞表型分析及CRISPR筛选（即Perturb-seq思路）结合，系统追踪神经退行性疾病风险变异对小胶质细胞功能的影响。论文成功筛选出调控小胶质细胞分化、迁移与吞噬的遗传驱动因子（如LRRK2和TREM2位点），是单细胞转录组、CRISPR扰动与遗传因果推断结合的前沿范例。

title: Shared genetic architecture between digestive infectious diseases and cardiovascular diseases: a genome-wide cross-trait analysis
abstract: Background Digestive infectious diseases and cardiovascular diseases may share common genetic, inflammatory and immune-related mechanisms. However, the shared genetic architecture between these disease groups, the specific pleiotropic loci involved and the potential contribution of intestinal infectious diseases (IID) to cardiovascular risk remain incompletely understood. Methods We analysed publicly available genome-wide association study summary statistics for 36 binary traits of European ancestry, including 16 digestive infectious disease traits and 20 cardiovascular traits. Univariate linkage disequilibrium score regression was used to estimate SNP-based heritability and prioritise traits. Global and local genetic sharing were evaluated using cross-trait LDSC and SUPERGNOVA. Multi-trait analysis of GWAS, cross-trait sensitivity analyses, FM-summary fine-mapping and Bayesian colocalisation were used to identify and refine pleiotropic loci. Candidate genes and biological functions were investigated using MAGMA, tissue- and cell-type-specific enrichment analyses, transcriptome-wide association analysis and protein-wide association analysis. Bidirectional two-sample Mendelian randomisation and two-step mediation analyses using three independent gut microbiome GWAS resources were subsequently performed. Results Sixteen traits passed heritability quality control, yielding 39 trait pairs with significant global genetic correlations after Bonferroni correction. MTAG identified 41 candidate SNP records and 14 trait-pair-specific lead-SNP records representing eight unique SNPs; 39 candidate records and 12 lead records involved IID. Fine-mapping and colocalisation prioritised eight records representing four unique variants. Locus-based gene prioritisation retained 24 candidate genes across four pairs. Gene-set enrichment identified 43 significant trait-pair-GO term associations, and tissue enrichment identified seven significant associations. Transcriptome-wide analyses implicated 21 candidate genes, and proteome-wide analyses identified four associations involving three proteins. After false discovery rate (FDR) correction, forward MR supported associations of IID liability with cardiac arrhythmias, myocardial infarction, atrial fibrillation and flutter, and ischaemic heart disease; reverse MR supported only cardiac arrhythmias to IID. Five positive exploratory microbiota-IID-cardiovascular mediation patterns were described. Only the Oxalobacter-IID-cardiac arrhythmias indirect effect reached unadjusted P < 0.05. Conclusions Digestive infectious diseases, particularly IID, share substantial genetic architecture with cardiovascular diseases. Integrative genetic analyses identified recurrent pleiotropic loci, candidate genes and putative microbiome-mediated pathways linking IID with cardiovascular outcomes. These findings provide testable hypotheses for further functional validation and clinical investigation.
score_reason: Implements an extensive causal inference and cross-trait statistical pipeline: LDSC, SUPERGNOVA, MTAG, FM-summary fine-mapping, colocalization, TWAS, PWAS, bidirectional 2-sample MR, and gut microbiome mediation.
chinese_explanation: 该研究利用16种消化道传染病与20种心血管疾病的GWAS汇总数据，集成了SUPERGNOVA、MTAG、精细定位、贝叶斯共定位、TWAS、PWAS以及双向两样本孟德尔随机化（MR）和中介分析。研究全面展示了如何利用多性状GWAS与MR方法解析复杂疾病间的共享遗传架构与因果中介路径。

title: The genetic and proteomic determinants of pediatric stature development and their link to adult height and type 2 diabetes
abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  
                    Stature is a key indicator of pediatric health, yet the molecular and metabolic architecture governing childhood growth remains incompletely defined. We conduct genome-wide association analyses of stature from birth to childhood (574,580 measurements; 72,704 Norwegian children) and integrate UK Biobank data (age 10 and adulthood). We uncover life-stage shifts in the genetics of stature, identifying previously not identified childhood-specific effects including variants near
                    <jats:italic>GLP1R</jats:italic>
                    with BMI-independent effects, and reveal three temporal clusters - Infancy and Childhood clusters enriched for endocrine and metabolic pathways, and a Lifetime growth cluster enriched for skeletal biology. Proteome analysis reveals that prepubertal height is associated with widespread changes in the circulation, identifying 106 height-associated proteins and linking IGF1, IGF2, and IGFBP3 levels to childhood-height polygenic scores. Mendelian randomization shows that reduced fetal growth and taller prepubertal height increase type 2 diabetes risk, independent of adult stature. These findings uncover developmental stage-specific genetic and proteomic influences on child-growth and links to adult metabolic health.
score_reason: Integrates longitudinal pediatric height GWAS, temporal growth clustering, plasma proteomics, and Mendelian randomization to infer causal effects of childhood growth trajectories on adult type 2 diabetes.
chinese_explanation: 作者对超过7.2万名挪威儿童的57万余次生长测量数据开展了涵盖从出生到儿童期身高的GWAS分析，并整合了蛋白质组数据（识别出106个与身高相关的蛋白）。研究进一步运用孟德尔随机化（MR）证实了胎儿生长受限和前青春期身高增高对2型糖尿病风险的独立因果影响，为纵向GWAS与MR多组学因果分析提供了优质参考。

title: Homeostatic fibroblast niche collapse in clinically uninvolved skin defines a subclinical state of systemic sclerosis
abstract: Systemic sclerosis, or scleroderma, is a chronic autoimmune disease characterized by vasculopathy, immune dysregulation, and progressive fibrosis of the skin and internal organs. Heterogeneous clinical presentation and polygenic risk complicate our understanding of disease mechanisms and the path to effective therapy. Single-cell transcriptomic analyses have revealed substantial heterogeneity in skin, but disease-associated reprogramming remains poorly defined. To address this, we performed high-resolution spatial transcriptomic profiling of paired clinically uninvolved and clinically affected scleroderma donor skin alongside healthy controls. We identified a continuum of cellular, molecular, and spatial changes to the stroma that were already evident in clinically uninvolved tissue yet remained distinct from the more extensive changes in paired fibrotic biopsies. Uninvolved skin was comparable to healthy tissue by clinical and histopathological assessment, but distinguishable by the proportional reduction, transcriptional reprogramming, and spatial isolation of LGR5+SCARA5+PI16+ progenitor fibroblasts. In parallel, the dermal vascular smooth muscle compartment shifted from a contractile to a synthetic, activated state, suggesting dysfunctional vascular reprogramming occurs in the absence of overt fibrosis. Cell neighborhood analysis revealed that progenitor fibroblasts occupy dense stromal niches in healthy skin that collapse in clinically uninvolved tissue, replaced by isolated, disease-associated fibroblast populations. These data indicate that clinically uninvolved skin occupies an intermediate subclinical state of scleroderma, establishing a framework for strategies to allow early diagnosis and preserve homeostatic fibroblast niches to prevent irreversible tissue remodeling and fibrotic commitment.
score_reason: Uses high-resolution spatial and single-cell transcriptomics to map cell-neighborhood dynamics, progenitor fibroblast populations, and differential expression in systemic sclerosis.
chinese_explanation: 该研究利用高分辨率空间转录组学与单细胞转录组学对系统性硬化症患者的未受累及受累皮肤组织进行分析，揭示了前体成纤维细胞（LGR5+SCARA5+PI16+）在亚临床状态下的微环境塌陷与转录重编程。论文展示了如何将单细胞分析、差异表达与空间细胞邻域（cell neighborhood analysis）结合起来研究疾病演进。

title: Multiancestry genome-wide association and integrative multiomics analyses implicate key pathways in endometriosis
abstract:
Nature Genetics, Published online: 20 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41588-026-02810-9

Multiancestry genome-wide association coupled with integrative multiomics analyses identify risk loci for endometriosis and implicate key genes and pathways underlying its pathogenesis, including roles for immune cell types and cellular proliferation.
score_reason: Multi-ancestry GWAS integrated with multiomics data to prioritize causal genes, biological pathways, and cell-type specific immune mechanisms.
chinese_explanation: 该论文通过多种族/多人群GWAS与多组学整合分析，识别出子宫内膜异位症的新风险位点，并阐明了特定免疫细胞类型与细胞增殖通路在发病中的作用。对于研究多人群GWAS整合、表达/多组学数据共定位及致病通路优先化具有积极参考价值。

title: Brain Cell-Type-Specific X-Chromosome Gene Regulation Reveals Sex-Biased Candidate Genes in Neurodegeneration
abstract: The impact of X-chromosome dosage on gene regulation in specific brain cell-types may importantly shape sex differences in neurodegenerative diseases but remains poorly resolved. We therefore mapped X-chromosome genetic effects on gene expression, i.e. cis-expression quantitative trait loci (cis-eQTL), across seven brain cell-types from 423 old-age individuals. We identified 212 X-linked genes whose expression was genetically regulated, with the majority being cell-type specific. Notably, 10 of these genes (~5%) showed sex-heterogeneous genetic regulation. Through sex-differential expression analyses we further discovered 101 sex-biased genes that were predominantly female-upregulated most strikingly in microglia. Sex-biased gene expression showed both shared and distinct cell-type effects, appearing most divergent in non-neuronal populations. Many female-biased genes overlapped known escape-from-X-inactivation genes and were enriched for links to Alzheimer's disease. Finally, we integrated our resource with X-chromosome-wide association studies of neurodegenerative diseases through causal inference approaches including transcriptome-wide association, mendelian randomization, and colocalization analyses to nominate 11 candidate causal genes, linked to their respective cell-types and sex-informed mechanisms, for Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and Multiple System Atrophy. Altogether, our findings suggest escape from X chromosome inactivation may contribute to sex differences in neurodegeneration and provide a resource to advance sex-informed insights into disease pathogenesis and therapeutic opportunities.
score_reason: Maps cell-type-specific X-chromosome cis-eQTLs in human brain and integrates them with GWAS via TWAS, Mendelian randomization, and colocalization to prioritize causal disease genes.
chinese_explanation: 该研究针对X染色体在脑部不同细胞类型中的遗传调控机制进行了系统映射，在7种脑细胞类型中鉴定出X染色体cis-eQTL。论文进一步整合了TWAS、孟德尔随机化（MR）和共定位（colocalization）等因果推断方法，解析了神经退行性疾病中细胞类型特异且具有性别偏向的候选致病基因。

title: CELL-X: A Single-Cell Transcriptomics Framework for Cell-Type and Disease-State Prioritization of Type 2 Diabetes Risk Genes
abstract: Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified hundreds of loci associated with Type 2 Diabetes (T2D), yet pinpointing specific causal genes and their relevant cellular contexts remains a critical bottleneck. To address this gap, we developed CELL-X, a novel computational framework systematically integrating fine-mapped genetic evidence with high-resolution single-cell transcriptomics and disease progression dynamics. Utilizing a custom out-of-memory processing engine, we analyzed an integrated human pancreatic islet atlas of 245,878 cells without forced data downsampling. We evaluated 37 genetically supported T2D candidate genes, quantifying cell-type relevance via a max-scaled Cell Relevance Score (CRS). Disease-associated transcriptional dynamics were subsequently incorporated using a Disease Relevance Score (DRS) based on heterogeneous expression shifts across normal, prediabetic, and T2D metabolic states. CELL-X successfully identified beta cells as the dominant disease-relevant cellular context and prioritized established causal genes, including SLC30A8, GLIS3, GCK, and TCF7L2. Validation against a 30-gene benchmark demonstrated exceptional target recovery and significant metabolic pathway enrichment. Furthermore, rigorous statistical null modeling confirmed this prioritization is driven by true biological variance rather than background transcriptomic noise. Ultimately, CELL-X provides a highly scalable, robust framework for generating biologically informed hypotheses in complex polygenic disease research.
score_reason: Develops CELL-X, a single-cell framework integrating fine-mapped GWAS evidence with scRNA-seq disease atlases to prioritize candidate risk genes and cell types.
chinese_explanation: 该论文提出了CELL-X计算框架，将GWAS精细定位（fine-mapping）证据与高分辨率单细胞转录组学及疾病状态结合，建立了细胞相关性得分（CRS）与疾病相关性得分（DRS）。该方法在不强制下采样的情况下分析了24.5万个胰岛细胞，为整合GWAS与单细胞数据提供了可借鉴的方法思路。

title: Spatial organization of a SPINK1-associated tumor-stromal ecosystem links metabolic remodeling to immune restriction in bladder cancer
abstract: Spatially organized tumor-stromal interactions contribute to metabolic remodeling and immune suppression in bladder cancer (BLCA). Using spatial transcriptional programs to define single-cell states, we identified a niche comprising SPINK1-high epithelial cells (E2) and TPM2-high cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) (C1). SPINK1 promoted tumor growth and myofibroblastic CAF programs, with EGFR and TGF-{beta} signaling implicated in tumor-CAF communication. Inferred metabolic reactions and spatial metabolite distributions supported a candidate circuit linking tumor-derived lactate to CAF oxidative metabolism and glutamine provision, followed by tumor glutamine utilization for reductive carboxylation and fatty acid synthesis. SPINK1 perturbation altered extracellular glutamine and lactate concentrations. Predicted chemokine interactions implicated C2/C3 CAFs in T cell recruitment, whereas the E2-C1 niche exhibited checkpoint and exhaustion-associated features. RHCG-positive tumor regions contained higher proportions of TOXCXCR4 cells among CD3 T cells, suggesting a possible association between ammonia handling and T cell dysfunction. In vivo, Spink1 loss attenuated tumor progression, increased cytotoxic CD8 T-cell infiltration, and enhanced tumor control during PD-1 blockade. These findings identify a spatially organized tumor-stromal niche associated with metabolic cooperation and immune restriction, supporting SPINK1 as a candidate therapeutic target in combination with immunotherapy.
score_reason: Combines single-cell RNA-seq and spatial transcriptomics to construct cell-cell communication and metabolic interaction networks in complex tissue niches.
chinese_explanation: 该研究结合单细胞转录组学与空间转录组分析，解析了膀胱癌中特定肿瘤细胞与癌相关成纤维细胞（CAF）构成的微环境生态。文章通过数据推断了细胞间乳酸与谷氨酰胺交换的代谢通路，为单细胞水平上的微环境与细胞间通讯建模提供了实际分析案例。

title: The tumor suppressor role of the KRAS proto-oncogene in metastatic pancreatic cancer.
abstract: KRAS is the most frequently mutated proto-oncogene in human cancers. Progression to advanced disease is frequently associated with allelic imbalance of the KRAS locus with gain of the mutant allele and loss of the wild-type allele through clonal and sub-clonal loss of heterozygosity (LOH). While a large body of literature has focused on the effects of allelic imbalance on oncogene addiction through gain of the mutant allele, the role of the wild-type KRAS proto-oncogene in malignant progression has not been fully elucidated. To capture this phenomenon, we developed a first-in-class somatic mosaic and lineage tracing genetically engineered mouse model (smGMLT) of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma allowing for real time in vivo tracing of Kras-LOH. Longitudinal characterization of the smGMLT demonstrated the presence of a strong evolutionary bottleneck towards the selective loss of the wild-type allele at metastatic sites. Cross species analysis leveraging research autopsies and surgical specimens revealed that KRAS-LOH is associated with metastatic dissemination and shorter overall survival. Transcriptomic analysis through single-cell RNA sequencing uncovered a conserved phenomenon whereby KRAS-LOH is paralleled by an immune evasive phenotype through loss of the tumor-cell interferon response and reduced CD8+ T cell infiltration. In line with this evidence, orthotopic transplants of isogenic tumor populations differing for the Kras allelic status demonstrated that only cancer cells with Kras-LOH are are able to form tumors in immune competent animals. Restoration of the wild-type allele abrogates tumorigenesis in KrasLOH transplants in immunocompetent through activation of the TBK1-IRF axis. Altogether, these studies demonstrate that the KRAS proto-oncogene is a functional tumor suppressor in pancreatic cancer exerting its function through interferon-mediated, cell-extrinsic modulation of the tumor immune microenvironment.
score_reason: Uses single-cell RNA sequencing alongside lineage tracing mouse models to explore subclonal evolution and immune evasion pathways driven by allele loss.
chinese_explanation: 该论文构建了新型基因工程小鼠模型，并利用单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）探究了Kras杂合性缺失（LOH）对肿瘤演化及免疫逃逸转录程序的影响。尽管侧重于肿瘤生物学，但其结合谱系追踪与单细胞转录组解析细胞异质性的思路具有参考价值。

title: Circulating miRNA profiling identifies hsa-miR-23a-3p and a three-miRNA signature associated with serous ovarian cancer
abstract: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (HGSOC) is the most lethal subtype of epithelial ovarian cancer, highlighting the need for minimally invasive biomarkers that support disease detection and molecular characterization. Circulating microRNAs (miRNAs) have emerged as promising candidates, although their clinical applicability remains limited by methodological variability and insufficient validation. Plasma samples from 100 individuals (50 patients with ovarian cancer and 50 cancer-free controls) were initially collected from four biobanks. Following quality control, 94 samples (47 patients and 47 controls) were included in the final analysis. Eight candidate miRNAs were quantified using RT-qPCR, and relative expression was assessed following global mean normalization. Differential expression was evaluated using the Wilcoxon rank-sum test, while discriminatory performance was assessed using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis. Three-miRNA logistic regression models were additionally explored using repeated stratified five-fold cross-validation. Among the eight candidates, hsa-miR-23a-3p exhibited significantly lower circulating expression in patients with ovarian cancer than in controls (p = 2.14 x 10^-5), achieving an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.755 (95% CI, 0.657-0.852), with 93.6% sensitivity and 53.2% specificity at the selected threshold. Exploratory analysis across FIGO stages revealed heterogeneous expression patterns, although the limited number of early-stage cases precluded definitive conclusions regarding stage-specific performance. A three-miRNA signature comprising hsa-miR-23a-3p, hsa-miR-21-5p, and hsa-miR-20a-5p achieved an apparent AUC of 0.798. However, repeated cross-validation yielded a mean AUC of 0.716 +/- 0.022, indicating reduced performance after internal validation. Variability in exogenous spike-in Ct values and the marked imbalance in biobank representation between study groups highlighted potential pre-analytical confounding. Circulating hsa-miR-23a-3p showed moderate discriminatory performance between patients with ovarian cancer and cancer-free controls, supporting its further investigation as a candidate liquid biopsy biomarker. Although combining three miRNAs improved apparent classification performance, this advantage was not established through internal validation. These findings underscore the importance of accounting for sample provenance, technical variability, and model overfitting when evaluating circulating miRNA signatures. Independent validation in appropriately balanced cohorts is required before clinical applicability can be established.
score_reason: Analyzes differential expression of circulating miRNAs using nonparametric testing and cross-validated multi-variable logistic regression, highlighting biobank confounding risks.
chinese_explanation: 该研究评估了血浆miRNA在卵巢癌中的差异表达（differential expression）与诊断价值，应用了Wilcoxon检验与多指标联合回归模型。研究特别探讨了技术变异与生物样本库混杂因素对差异表达和模型过拟合的影响，对组学统计分析中的混杂控制有提醒作用。

title: Contrastive Proxy Forests: Completeness-Preserving Proxy Learning from Multimodal Records
abstract: Proximal causal inference removes unmeasured confounding using two proxies of the confounder, an outcome-side W and a treatment-side Z. The proxies must satisfy exclusion restrictions and be complete, meaning that they reflect every aspect of the confounder. In practice, they are a few variables hand-picked from a structured table, even though clinical notes and physiological waveforms carry rich information about the confounder. Such records are too high-dimensional for a proximal estimator, and generic compression such as PCA may keep modality-specific variation (style) instead of the confounder, destroying completeness. Our key observation is that, under the proximal condition, the confounder is the only link between a treatment-side and an outcome-side modality beyond the covariates. Learning what they share therefore captures the confounder and filters out modality-specific style. Contrastive Proxy Forests (CPF) learns both proxies by contrasting the two modalities, given the covariates, on a separate unlabeled sample, and passes them to a proximal causal forest. This contrastive objective has an exact closed-form solution, ridge canonical correlation analysis. We prove that CPF preserves the exclusion restrictions exactly and that its proxies inherit the completeness of the raw records under conditions we characterize. Where style is strong, CPF lowers the error of conditional effects by 10-22% relative to PCA proxies, and on MIMIC-IV it is the only method whose point estimate of warfarin's effect on stroke falls inside the range of randomized trials.
score_reason: Introduces Contrastive Proxy Forests (CPF) for proximal causal inference, using ridge canonical correlation analysis to construct completeness-preserving confounder proxies from multimodal data while enforcing exclusion restrictions.
chinese_explanation: 该论文提出了 Contrastive Proxy Forests (CPF)，针对近端因果推断（proximal causal inference）中未观测混杂因子的代理变量构造难题展开攻关。论文利用岭典型相关分析（ridge CCA）在处理端与结果端的多模态数据之间学习共享混杂特征，在保证排除性约束的前提下保留混杂因子的完整性，对扩展工具变量与近端因果推断方法极具参考价值。

title: EPIC2: integrating single-cell chromatin accessibility with human genetics to identify trait-relevant cell types
abstract: Summary: EPIC2 is a computational and statistical framework for prioritizing trait-relevant cellular contexts by integrating genome-wide association study (GWAS) summary statistics with single-cell chromatin accessibility data. It accounts for linkage disequilibrium when testing for association between GWAS association strength and cell-type-specific chromatin accessibility at both SNP and regulatory-peak resolutions. The resulting P-values are combined using the Cauchy combination test. Availability and Implementation: The core workflow is implemented in R, with source code, vignettes, and reproducible test data freely available at https://github.com/LingxuanZ/EPIC2. Supplementary Information: Supplementary material accompanies this preprint.
score_reason: Presents EPIC2, a statistical framework that integrates GWAS summary statistics with single-cell chromatin accessibility while accounting for linkage disequilibrium and combining multi-resolution P-values via the Cauchy combination test.
chinese_explanation: EPIC2 提出了一个将 GWAS 汇总统计数据与单细胞染色质可及性数据高度集成的统计学框架。该方法在充分考虑连锁不平衡（LD）的前提下，分别在 SNP 和调控峰两个分辨率层面检验 GWAS 关联强度与细胞类型特异性开放染色质的关联，并采用 Cauchy 组合检验融合 P 值，是单细胞数据与 GWAS 遗传学整合分析的优秀示例。

title: LRCP: identifying functionally related SNPs and genes from phenome-wide genetic-effect correlations using GWAS summary statistics
abstract: Genetic correlation describes which traits share genetic causes. The transposed question, which variants act alike across the phenome, has no comparable estimator, although it points directly to shared genes, pathways and regulators. Correlations of GWAS Z scores between variants across many traits are easy to compute, but they are confounded by linkage disequilibrium (LD) and, for any pair of variants, by sample overlap and genetic correlation among the GWAS. We show that in 452 Pan-UK Biobank GWAS the effective number of independent traits is only 58, and that naive tests reject 51-70% of null pairs of distal variants. We introduce LRCP (likelihood and regression on cross-products of Z scores), which estimates the phenome-wide genetic-effect correlation{rho} between SNPs by regressing Z-score cross-products on LD cross components, using per-SNP heritability enrichment from the companion method LRCQ and LDSC-derived plug-ins. For variants in different LD blocks the estimator has a closed form, and its standard errors account exactly for the dependence among GWAS. In simulations LRCP is unbiased (absolute bias at most 0.03), its 95% intervals cover 93-98%, and its type-I error is 5.0-5.7%, whereas naive correlations are attenuated by 41-64% and reject up to 51% of null pairs. In Pan-UK Biobank, LRCP recovers the expected signs among PCSK9, LDLR and APOB variants and estimates{rho} = 0.90 between the TP53 polyadenylation variant rs78378222 and MDM2 rs3730556, whose Z scores correlate at r = 0.67 across traits (conditional bootstrap P = 0.015), although this correlation lies along a shared body-size and red-cell trait axis. Single variant pairs are near the resolution of current biobanks, with precision limited by the number of genetically distinct traits. Genome-wide, among 1,799 strongly enriched LD clumps (1.61 million distal pairs), a conditional test finds 437 pairs at FDR 5%, where naive correlation flags 1.1 million. Simulating the whole screen under the null shows that this test is conservative and that the 386 strongest links (P < 10-5) lie beyond every one of 322 million simulated null statistics. Linked genes share GO biological processes 1.9 times more often than random pairs of enriched loci. The links form 14 modules that match known biology, among them platelet and red-cell production, lipoprotein metabolism (PCSK9, LDLR, APOB, CETP, LPL), myeloid differentiation (IRF8, ITGA4), bone density (WNT16), pigmentation (HERC2, SLC45A2), alkaline phosphatase (ALPL, GPLD1) and IL-6 signalling (IL6R, CRP). Most modules act within one trait domain, where LRCP shows shared trait profiles rather than a tested shared mechanism. Once LD and the dependence among GWAS are modelled, phenome-wide summary statistics can identify functionally related variants and genes.
score_reason: Develops LRCP to estimate phenome-wide genetic-effect correlations between pairs of variants using multi-trait GWAS summary statistics, removing confounding from LD and sample overlap.
chinese_explanation: LRCP 针对跨表型组（phenome-wide）计算 SNP 位点间遗传效应相关性的难题，提出了基于 Z 分数交叉乘积回归的统计估计器。该方法显式地对连锁不平衡（LD）交叉项、样本重叠以及 GWAS 表型间相关性进行校正，解决了传统方法高达 51%-70% 的伪阳性率问题，为探索多性状多效性（pleiotropy）与共享通路提供了稳健的推断工具。

title: LRCQ: phenome-wide heritability enrichment of genomic loci from GWAS summary statistics
abstract: Some genetic variants are associated with many traits, but a variant's GWAS statistics are also inflated by the effects of variants in LD with it and by confounding shared by all variants in a study. Existing measures of per-variant pleiotropy, such as counts of significant associations or multi-trait association tests, do not separate these sources. Stratified LD score regression separates them for one trait at a time and only through predefined annotations. We present LRCQ (LD score regression on {chi}2 across many GWAS), which estimates for each locus its phenome-wide heritability enrichment: the variance of its causal effects across a set of traits, relative to an average locus. LRCQ regresses squared Z-scores from 30 or more GWAS jointly on squared LD, with per-trait LDSC intercepts and heritabilities fitted in earlier stages. Its pooled least-squares solution has a closed form whose cost does not grow with the number of traits. Its standard errors account for sample overlap and genetic correlation between GWAS. Squared Z-scores identify enrichment at the resolution of LD clumps, not single SNPs, so LRCQ reports clump-level estimates ("omni-loci"). These estimates can be aggregated over any functional annotation or gene set chosen after the analysis. In simulations with real UK Biobank LD and 30 to 1,000 traits, LRCQ was unbiased for its clump-level estimand. When GWAS share samples its test statistics are strongly right-skewed: normal-reference p-values were up to 10-fold anti-conservative at P < 0.001. P-values matched to the exact third cumulant restored type-I error and FDR control, and matching the fourth cumulant as well kept the far tail within 1.6-fold of nominal down to P = 10-4. Score-type tests, which evaluate the variance under the null hypothesis, kept power at the most enriched loci. Model-based standard errors were calibrated once the enrichment estimates plugged into them kept the polygenic background. It ranked enriched loci better than mean {chi}2, LD-normalised {chi}2, multi-trait omnibus tests and significant-association counts in 13 of 16 scenarios. Its main vulnerability was a misspecified LDSC intercept. Applied to 444 Pan-UK Biobank European-ancestry GWAS, LRCQ found strongly non-uniform phenome-wide enrichment: the SD of true clump-mean enrichment was 8.3, against a genome mean of 1. At a tag-level FDR of 5%, 881 LD clumps were enriched above the uniform expectation; they fall in 638 distinct loci, including FTO, AXIN2, HBS1L-MYB, CST3, CELSR2-SORT1, PCSK9 and MC4R. These ranked only moderately with mean {chi}2 and poorly with counts of significant associations. Gene-level phenome-wide enrichment rose with loss-of-function constraint. Phenome-wide heritability was 3-5-fold enriched in coding, conserved, 5' UTR and promoter sequence, and depleted in repressed chromatin. LRCQ turns hundreds of biobank GWAS into an LD-corrected map of where phenome-wide genetic variance lies, and complements its companion method LRCP, which estimates genetic-effect correlations between loci.
score_reason: Introduces LRCQ to measure phenome-wide heritability enrichment (pleiotropy) across dozens to hundreds of GWAS summary statistics, incorporating exact cumulant matching to correct for skewed test statistics.
chinese_explanation: LRCQ 提出了一种利用数十至数百个 GWAS 汇总统计量评估特定基因座表型组遗传率富集度（即多效性 pleiotropy）的封闭解估计方法。论文针对样本重叠导致的检验统计量严重右偏现象，创新性地使用三阶和四阶累积量匹配技术对 P 值进行校准，确保了多性状遗传多效性检测的假阳性率控制与检验功效。

title: Cell-state conditioning predicts the expression response to an unseen stimulus but not stimulus-dependent genetic effects
abstract: Background: Second-generation sequence models can be conditioned on a cell state supplied as a single-cell snapshot rather than selected from a fixed catalogue, but whether that conditioning carries an experimentally applied perturbation has not been tested. Results: We conditioned such a model on interferon-{beta}-stimulated and unstimulated monocytes from a published experiment, using cells disjoint from those providing the measurement, and asked whether the predicted expression response tracks the measured one and whether the same conditioning identifies expression QTL specific to the stimulated state. Predicted and measured responses agree at Spearman {rho} = 0.616 across 119 genes (95% CI 0.486 to 0.716), and at 0.607 after all 119 target genes are deleted from the conditioning input; across fifteen conditions the model's response scales with how much each condition's biology genuinely overlaps the target response (slope 0.73, Pearson 0.92), and a near-neighbour monocyte subset receives 0.295 against a measured overlap of 0.336. For stimulation-specific genetic effects we find no reliable evidence: the pre-specified primary arm moves from p = 0.0019 to 0.443 once both conditions must carry a measurable predicted effect, and the separation localises to the resting-condition baseline. Neither model generation's catalogue contains a perturbed sample, 0 of 4,430 tracks and 0 of 2,799 conditions, although both carry activation-state labels, so the gap is experimental perturbation rather than cell state. Two incidental findings apply beyond this model: credible-set membership mislabels over half of putatively condition-specific loci, and gating a ratio statistic on its larger term manufactures signal. Conclusions: Conditioning therefore conveys the state but not the mechanism: transfer between states is supported at the level of expression and unsupported at the level of variant effect, and an evaluation that separates the two is needed before either is claimed.
score_reason: Critically evaluates single-cell sequence models on predicting expression responses versus stimulus-dependent eQTL genetic effects, uncovering key theoretical and statistical pitfalls in conditional eQTL mapping.
chinese_explanation: 该论文系统评估了单细胞预训练模型在预测单细胞表达扰动响应及刺激特异性 eQTL 遗传效应方面的表现。研究表明模型虽能预测表达量的状态转移，但无法有效捕捉变异位点层面的基因型-刺激交互作用；同时揭示了可信集（credible-set）与比率统计量在鉴定条件特异性 eQTL 时常见的假阳性陷阱，对单细胞 eQTL 及 perturb-seq 分析具有重要指导意义。
